4 of 5 claims supported. Only defect: the owner's 'everyone can eat safely' quote is cited to a paywalled Chunichi article but sits verbatim on the weekend-kanazawa entry already used elsewhere on the record. GF 'high' label is consistent with the sources (batter-level wheat-free wording, no whole-kitchen statement).

4 of 6 claims supported; 2 need their URL swapped to manpuku-kanazawa.com/miron/, which carries the egg-free/vegan/28-allergen wording and the allergy-parent founding story. GF 'high' label is well supported (national all-GF bakery directory, ★★★★, no wheat on premises).

GF side is sound — 「小麦粉は一切使わず」 on the cited page, ★★★★★ in the national directory — but the vegan claim ('whole bakery is plant-based') is contradicted by SOYA's own shop, which sells sausage, bacon, tuna and cheese breads. The vegan:'full' label must be downgraded. Separately, the 'empacede' guide named in the positives claim does not appear to exist.

Wheat-free production is genuine ('Made in gluten free factory', 100% Koshihikari rice flour, no wheat gluten), but two claims assert a workshop free of dairy, which the site never says and which the shop's own cheese pizzas contradict. Rewrite both to the free-from list the site actually gives (gluten, egg, buckwheat, nuts).

The dedicated-GF status is solidly sourced three ways (Find Me GF, Tabelog, endlessdistances, plus toshoan.com's own 「都松庵のあんこ菓子はすべてグルテンフリー」). The defect is the Miyako Monaka production-line cross-contact exception, asserted as 'documented' on two claims and traceable to no source at all — not Find Me GF, not the three MIYAKO MONAKA product pages, not Tabelog.

9 of 11 claims supported, several verbatim. The two failures are the same false attribution stated twice: the restaurant is quoted as saying its dishes are gluten-free 'including the seasonings' / 'down to the seasonings, so condiments like soy sauce are accounted for', when its official page says only 「お料理全品グルテンフリー」 and never mentions sauce or soy sauce.

The GF core is excellent and quoted verbatim from the owner, including his own severe-allergy caution. But one positive claims the drinks are gluten-free, which the owner explicitly disclaims (「ビールやウイスキーを提供しております」), and the owner/head-chef claim is cited to a Tabelog page that says nothing of the kind.

The vegan side is airtight (Tabelog: free of meat, fish, eggs, dairy and honey). The GF side is not: the cited hs-choice.com/en_message page names an ancient-wheat pasta exception, insidekyoto excepts the pasta dishes, and two claims nonetheless assert a 100%-GF building and a whole menu safe to order from. Verify the current pasta with the shop before the gf:'dedicated' label stands.
